zh: 有人拿她的口音开玩笑，她只是一笑置之。
en: People joked about her accent, but she just {laughed off|shrugged off|brushed off|ignored} the comments.

zh: 我睡前看会儿书让自己放松下来。
en: I read a book to {wind down|unwind|relax} before bed.

zh: 老是把情绪憋在心里不健康。
en: It's not healthy to keep {bottling up|holding in|keeping in|suppressing|hiding} your feelings.

zh: 她最近正在经历一段艰难的时期。
en: She's {going through} a really tough time at the moment.

zh: 她在演讲时眼眶湿了。
en: She {teared up|welled up|got teary} during the speech.

zh: 没人告诉我这件事，我有点不爽。
en: I was a bit {ticked off|annoyed|irritated|peeved} that nobody told me.

zh: 吵完架他就气冲冲地走了。
en: He {stormed off|stormed out|walked off|stalked off} after the argument.

zh: 别让他影响到你，他对谁都那样。
en: Don't let him {get to|bother|upset|annoy} you. He's like that with everyone.

zh: 我下班以后很难放松下来。
en: I find it hard to {switch off|unwind|relax|wind down} after work.

zh: 开心点！又不是世界末日。
en: {Cheer up}! It's not the end of the world.

zh: 我真不敢相信奥克兰变化这么大。
en: I can't {get over} how much Auckland has changed.

zh: 他一气之下把那封信撕了。
en: He {ripped up|tore up} the letter in anger.

zh: 搬家的事让我压力很大。
en: I'm really {stressed out|stressed} about the move.

zh: 她看到蜘蛛时尖叫了一声。
en: She {let out|gave} a scream when she saw the spider.

zh: 放轻松，我们时间多得是。
en: Just {chill out|relax|calm down|settle down}. We've got plenty of time.

zh: 这差不多就是我这一周的写照。
en: That pretty much {sums up} my week.

zh: 山顶的风景让我惊呆了。
en: I was {blown away|amazed|stunned|wowed} by the view from the summit.

zh: 他压力太大，冲同事发了火。
en: He was so stressed that he {lashed out|snapped|exploded} at his colleagues.

zh: 离婚后他整个人都垮了。
en: He {fell apart|went to pieces|broke down} after his divorce.

zh: 我在倒数着放假的日子。
en: I'm {counting down} the days until the holidays.

zh: 今年夏天过得真快。
en: This summer {went by|flew by|passed} so quickly.

zh: 他对那些批评一笑置之。
en: He {shrugged off|brushed off|laughed off|dismissed|ignored} the criticism.

zh: 别那么严肃，放松点！
en: Don't be so serious, {lighten up|relax|chill out|chill}!

zh: 我现在应付不了这件事。
en: I can't {deal with|handle|cope with|face} this right now.

zh: 她听到这个消息时忍不住哭了。
en: She {broke down} in tears when she heard the news.

zh: 吵完架给他几分钟冷静一下。
en: Give him a few minutes to {cool off|cool down|calm down|settle down} after the argument.

zh: 我今晚没精力出去。
en: I don't {feel up to|feel like} going out tonight.

zh: 分手都一年了，你该放下往前走了。
en: It's been a year since the break-up. It's time to {move on}.

zh: 她看到那只蜘蛛的时候吓坏了。
en: She {freaked out|panicked|lost it} when she saw the spider.

zh: 最近我不怎么喜欢喝咖啡了。
en: I've {gone off} coffee lately.

zh: 听到这个好消息，她立马精神起来了。
en: She {perked up|brightened up|cheered up|brightened} as soon as she heard the good news.

zh: 冷静点，只是擦破了点皮。
en: {Calm down|Relax|Chill out|Settle down}, it's only a scratch.
